k:瓶.mnemonic: The tile (瓦) maker has clay left over, so he shapes three (三) tall narrow vessels with stoppers and fires them in the kiln beside the roof tiles. Bottle (vial, jar, jug).
k:瓶.hint: Leftover tile clay, three stoppered vessels.

k:阻.mnemonic: A mound (阝) blocks the road, and moreover (且) a second and a third rise behind it, stacked like shelves. The army gives up and turns back. Thwart (separate from, prevent, obstruct).
k:阻.hint: Mound after mound across the road.

k:后.mnemonic: Under the overhang (厂) of the palace sits the one woman who can (可) order the royal axe (斤) put away with a single nod. Even the emperor walks behind her. Empress (queen, after, behind).
k:后.hint: Her nod stops the royal axe.

k:腐.mnemonic: Meat (肉) left on a desk in the government office (府), waiting for a stamp. The paperwork takes weeks and the smell fills every corridor. Rot (decay, sour).
k:腐.hint: Meat waiting weeks for a stamp.

k:挿.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) push a thousand (千) flowers into a single vase, stem by stem. Wherefore (由) so many? Because there is always a gap to slip one more into. Insert (put in, graft).
k:挿.hint: One more stem pushed into the vase.

k:癖.mnemonic: He has to reside (居) in a sickbed (疒) for weeks, yet still demands spicy (辛) sauce on his porridge and taps the bottle twice before pouring, as he always does. Mannerism (habit, vice, trait).
k:癖.hint: Two taps on the sauce bottle, always.

k:溝.mnemonic: The water left by a tsunami (氵) has to go somewhere: it runs under a stone hood (冂) crossed with gratings and away along the edge of the street. Gutter (ditch, sewer, drain).

k:腸.mnemonic: Coiled in the belly like party streamers (勿), so long that dinner needs until dawn (旦) to pass through and a snail would need a month (月). Intestines (guts, bowels, viscera).

k:擁.mnemonic: A tiny (幺) child runs at you with both arms out. No conjecture (推) is needed about what she wants: you scoop her up and hold her tight. Hug (embrace, possess, protect).

k:鉢.mnemonic: A monk reads aloud from a book (本) in one hand and holds out a round vessel in the other. Listeners drop gold (金) coins into it. Bowl (pot, rice tub, crown).

k:錦.mnemonic: A plain white (白) towel (巾) with gold (金) thread woven through it in dragons and waves, until it is fit for an emperor's sleeve. Brocade (fine dress, honors).
k:錦.hint: White cloth woven with gold dragons.

k:叙.mnemonic: The lord announces: 'Now (今) you receive a sheaf of grain (禾), and also (又) a title.' Then he tells the whole court the story of why. Confer (relate, narrate, describe).
k:叙.hint: Grain, a title, and the story why.

k:胃.mnemonic: A rice field (田) sitting on top of a month (月): the bag inside you where a whole month's harvest of rice ends up, one bowl at a time. Stomach (paunch, crop, craw).
k:胃.hint: Where a month of rice lands.

k:呪.mnemonic: A mouth (口) mutters strange words at a second mouth (口) on legs (儿), and those legs stop dead, rooted to the floor. Spell (curse, charm, malediction).

k:唇.mnemonic: The mouth (口) of a clam (辰): two soft edges that press tightly shut and open only a crack to let something in. Lips (mouth).
k:唇.hint: Soft edges of a clam's opening.

k:猶.mnemonic: The hound (犭) has licked one wine jar (酉) clean, and on top of that it is still nosing at the next one. There is always something more to add. Furthermore (still, yet).
k:猶.hint: Hound sniffing at yet another jar.

k:謙.mnemonic: Praise him and he will say (言) 'it was nothing', pick up his broom (ヨ) and go back to sweeping the corner. Self-effacing (humble oneself, condescend, be modest).
k:謙.hint: 'It was nothing,' then back to sweeping.

k:潔.mnemonic: A sword (刀) rinsed in a tsunami (氵) of clear water until only the elementary (素) bare steel remains, without one stain on it. Undefiled (pure, clean, righteous).
k:潔.hint: Blade rinsed down to bare steel.

k:囚.mnemonic: A person (人) with a fence (囗) on all four sides and no gate anywhere. Captured (criminal, arrest, catch).

k:墳.mnemonic: A chief is laid under the soil (土) with shellfish (貝) money for the journey. Ten (十) steps of earth are heaped over him and flowers (艹) planted on top. Tomb (mound).
k:墳.hint: Flowers on the heap over a chief.

k:峠.mnemonic: On the mountain (山) there is one spot where the climbing stops and everything is below (下) you: from here the path can only go down. Mountain peak (mountain pass, climax, crest).
k:峠.hint: Where up ends and down begins.

k:碑.mnemonic: A stone (石) set upright at the edge of the rice field (田), with a cross like a ten (十) cut into it to mark where the old farmer rests. Tombstone (monument).
k:碑.hint: Upright stone at the field's edge.

k:卑.mnemonic: Bent over in the rice field (田) for ten (十) hours a day, knee-deep in mud, bowing to everyone who passes on the road above. Lowly (base, vile, vulgar).
k:卑.hint: Knee-deep in mud, bowing to all.

k:摂.mnemonic: Too ill to go skating, you cup your fingers (扌) to your ear (耳) at the window and take in the skaters' fun through the icicles (冫), enjoying it second-hand. Vicarious (surrogate, act in addition to, take in).
k:摂.hint: Enjoying the skating from the window.

k:鋼.mnemonic: Ore dug from the knoll (岡) and forged so hard that a swordsmith values it far above gold (金). Steel.
k:鋼.hint: Hard metal forged from the knoll.

k:頻.mnemonic: The government ministry (省) sends your form back: stop (止), page (頁) three is wrong. You fix it and they send it back again, and again. Repeatedly (recur).
k:頻.hint: The form bounces back, again, again.

k:漂.mnemonic: A ballot (票) swept out of the polling station by the tsunami (氵) bobs away on the water, going wherever the current happens to take it. Drift (float).
k:漂.hint: A ballot bobbing off on the current.

k:炉.mnemonic: A fire (火) behind a small iron door (戸): open it to push in a log, shut it to keep the heat in the room. Hearth (furnace, kiln, reactor).
k:炉.hint: Fire behind a small iron door.

k:忌.mnemonic: A cobra (已) lies coiled on the heart (心), cold and heavy, ever since the death. On each anniversary it tightens a little. Mourning (abhor, detestable, death anniversary).
k:忌.hint: Cold coil resting on the heart.

k:恨.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) heartbeat (忄) that will not let the old wrong go: years later it still thumps hard every time you remember. Regret (bear a grudge, resentment, malice).
k:恨.hint: A thump that never lets go.
